title: Federated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) leverages centralized knowledge graphs to enhance large language models with structured knowledge retrieval. However, real-world knowledge is inherently distributed across multiple organizations rather than being centrally accessible. Privacy constraints further prohibit sharing entire local knowledge graphs, preventing GraphRAG from effectively retrieving and utilizing distributed knowledge. To this end, we propose Federated GraphRAG (FedGRAG), a unified framework for distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation over multiple clients with knowledge graphs. Specifically, we address two fundamental challenges in federated GraphRAG. First, the absence of a global knowledge graph makes unified retrieval impossible. To address this, we develop a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism that efficiently identifies relevant clients through lightweight knowledge indices without expos

translated_abstract: 图检索增强生成利用集中式知识图谱来增强大语言模型的结构化知识检索能力。然而，现实世界中的知识天然分布在多个组织之间，而非集中可访问。隐私约束进一步禁止共享完整的本地知识图谱，这阻碍了GraphRAG有效检索和利用分布式知识。为此，我们提出了联邦GraphRAG（FedGRAG），一个在多个拥有知识图谱的客户端上进行分布式图检索与知识增强生成的统一框架。具体而言，我们解决了联邦GraphRAG中的两个基本挑战。首先，由于缺乏全局知识图谱，统一检索无法实现。为解决这一问题，我们开发了联邦知识路由机制，通过轻量级知识索引高效识别相关客户端，而无需暴露本地数据。
tldr: 提出联邦GraphRAG（FedGRAG）统一框架，通过联邦知识路由机制在保护隐私的前提下解决缺乏全局知识图谱的检索难题，实现多客户端间的分布式图检索与知识增强生成。
en_tdlr: Proposes FedGRAG, a unified federated framework that enables privacy-preserving distributed graph retrieval and knowledge-enhanced generation across multiple clients by introducing a Federated Knowledge Routing mechanism to overcome the absence of a global knowledge graph.
